name: After recital 3
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1232 as regards the extension of its period of application
part_text: (3 c) Systematic or generalised monitoring of communications content, in particular automated scanning of text messages, should not be permitted under this framework. Detection measures should therefore be restricted to technologies that operate in a content-oblivious manner, such as the comparison of digital fimngerprints ("hashing"), or that function locally on a user's device prior to encryption, without affecting the integrity of end-to-end encryption.
